race.comment: More value to be found in another open maiden. MOVING POINT (12) has all the form on the board in tougher maiden fields than this, but he has to overcome a wide draw third up. With any luck in the running, he is the one to beat. COOL AZA BREEZE (6) failed to cope with a heavy track last time out at Warrnambool, and she will don the blinkers for the first time here. The extra 200m should help, and she can take this out. PATH TO VICTORY (3) ran some sound races last season, and he will be a lot stronger this time in work. He has had a recent jump-out, and with the aid of the pole position, he will be ready to run a big race fresh. Watch for him late. HIS LADY BAY (8) has yet to out is all together, and is lacking a bit of strength, Dropping back from 1700m to 1400m will do her no harm, and she is another with top 4 claims at odds.
